00045         IF ( reactant1 .EQ. ONUM ) THEN

00055       ISBARRIER = .FALSE.

00074       ! 1. Go through list of reactions and find all between reactant1 and r2

00087         n = n + 1

00116       ! 3. Based on reaction type, calculate rate coeff. and store that in data-structure
00117       SELECT CASE (pathways(1)%rtype)

00119         DO n=1,SIZE(vals,1)

00141     competition: IF ( barrier .GT. 0.0d0) THEN

00149         PRODS(3) = 0

00151         ISBARRIER = .TRUE.
00152       END IF
00153     END IF competition

00159     END IF

00168 RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE bumpreaction(id,node)
00169   !
00170   ! Purpose:
00171   !   This is a subroutine that takes some reaction id number and increments its
00172   !  counter for later analytics.
00173   !! BUMPREACTION !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00174   IMPLICIT NONE
00175   INTEGER            :: id
00176   type(reaction) :: node
00177 
00178   IF ( id .EQ. node%id ) THEN
00179     node%count = node%count + 1
00180     RETURN
00181   ELSE
00182     IF ( ASSOCIATED(node%next)) THEN
00183       CALL bumpreaction(id,node%next)
00184     ELSE
00185       PRINT *, id
00186       PRINT *, node%id
00187       PRINT *, "ERROR! No match in bumpreaction!"
00188       CALL EXIT()
00189     END IF
00190   END IF
00191   RETURN
00192 END SUBROUTINE bumpreaction

00194 SUBROUTINE selectbranch(kvals,ndex)
00195   ! This subroutine randomly selects a branching pathway
00196   ! based on the relative magnitude of the rate coefficient
00197   IMPLICIT NONE
00198   DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: kvals(4)

00200   INTEGER :: n
00201   DOUBLE PRECISION :: sumval

00203   DOUBLE PRECISION :: rand
00204 
00205   tempkvals = kvals
00206   sumval = SUM(tempkvals)
00207   tempkvals = tempkvals/sumval
00208 
00209   CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rand)
00210 
00211   DO n=1,SIZE(kvals,1)
00212     IF ( n .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00213       tempkvals(n) = tempkvals(n)
00214     ELSE
00215       tempkvals(n) = (tempkvals(n) + tempkvals(n-1))
00216     END IF
00217     ! Check to see if the  index is the lucky number
00218     IF ( rand .LE. tempkvals(n)) THEN
00219       EXIT
00220     END IF
00221   END DO
00222 
00223   ndex = n
00224   IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "The lucky number is ",ndex
00225 
00226 END SUBROUTINE selectbranch
